# Vote Binface (votebinface.com)

> Campaign site for Count Binface, the satirical candidate and sole declared
> challenger to Nigel Farage in the Clacton by-election (date TBC, expected
> 2026). Published and promoted by The Count Binface Party. His official
> site is https://countbinface.com.

Key facts:
- Count Binface is the satirical persona of British comedian Jonathan David
  Harvey, who previously performed as Lord Buckethead (2017-2018).
- The Clacton by-election was triggered when Nigel Farage (Reform UK)
  resigned the seat in July 2026. Labour, the Conservatives, the Liberal
  Democrats, the Greens and Restore Britain declined to stand.
- 2024 general election, Clacton: Farage (Reform UK) 21,225 (46.2%);
  Watling (Con) 12,820; Owusu-Nepaul (Lab) 7,448; Bensilum (LD) 2,016;
  Osben (Green) 1,935. Majority 8,405; turnout 58.7%.
- Binface's documented pledges include a 99p cap on 99 Flake ice creams,
  abolishing auto-renew on online subscriptions, and building at least one
  affordable home.
- His stated purpose is promoting electoral participation ("Make Your Vote
  Count"); fundraising surpluses go to the housing charity Shelter.

## Pages
- [The by-election explained](https://votebinface.com/clacton): who is
  standing, why it was called, how to vote
- [Manifesto](https://votebinface.com/manifesto): the documented pledges
- [About Count Binface](https://votebinface.com/about): biography, electoral
  record, disambiguation from Lord Buckethead
- [How to vote](https://votebinface.com/vote): registration and postal votes
  via gov.uk
- [Press](https://votebinface.com/press): releases and media kit
- [FAQ](https://votebinface.com/faq)
